column1: # SBE cases for the bounds oracle (#122); scripts/gen-sbe-oracle.sh runs them

#   marshal:   message, assignments path=value;... (grp+.e appends an entry, e*N appends N)
#   wire:      message, primitive bits in hex, written little-endian over an empty message's block
